semantic_metric_method.source: https://www.collectionscanada.gc.ca/obj/thesescanada/vol2/002/NR89158.PDF (chapter 7, definitions 7.3--7.10); Ensan and Du, Information Systems 38(5), 2013, doi:10.1016/j.is.2012.11.012
semantic_metric_method.required: Axiom and concept/role-symbol allocation to explicit modules, local/external signatures, interfaces and semantic strong/moderate dependency sets under the source definitions.
semantic_metric_method.available: Only catalog concept ownership and a derived single-ontology OWL graph; relations and axioms have not been allocated to executable modules with declared interfaces.
semantic_metric_method.rationale: Even n(n-1) would count only local class names, omitting roles; association/generalization edges do not determine entailment-based strong/moderate dependencies. Inventing COH/COP would misattribute graph observations to Ensan--Du.
semantic_metric_method.structural_columns: n/e/k/i/x/b are distinct observations in the pinned structural report, not semantic scores.
semantic_metric_method.uncertainty: Module partition and semantic dependence are undecided. No threshold or rank is justified.
